Jethalal teases Sodhi and nearly spills the beans in front of Roshan, but covers it up at the last second by asking Roshan to feed Sodhi jalebi-fafda. Jethalal leaves for Surat, warning Sodhi never to party alone again without inviting him.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
